ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The query is a constrained, low-latitude factual lookup with explicit formatting requirements — list exactly five items, no rambling. Both models score equivalently on Extraction & Retrieval (within the 2-point variance band), so capability isn't the deciding factor. Lapwing self-reports preferring precisely this kind of well-specified retrieval task with clear completion criteria, while it has a measured aversion to open-ended generative work. Matching the task to the model's stated preference is the tiebreaker, so Lapwing gets it.
